mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_delivery (recipient, subject, body, event_type, reference_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{recipient}, #{subject}, #{body}, #{eventType}, #{referenceId}, 'pending', 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_delivery SET status = 'sent', attempts = attempts + 1, sent_at = #{sentAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE mail_delivery SET status = #{status}, attempts = #{attempts}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mail_delivery WHERE reference_id IN #{rid}
DELETE FROM mail_delivery WHERE reference_id IN (SELECT id FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) OR reference_id IN (SELECT id FROM demand WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId})
